title: Summary MCUboot enforces several security-critical invariants on the boot, image-swap, and validation… (CVE-2026-16665)
description: MCUboot contains security-critical asserts that are disabled in production builds, causing important invariant checks to be skipped. This can lead to booting unvalidated firmware images when certain conditions are attacker-controllable via unauthenticated flash writes during device recovery or DFU. The most severe issue allows completing a firmware swap without validation, bypassing secure boot protections. Another issue involves reading swap metadata from attacker-writable flash areas without proper validation. These flaws violate image authenticity and secure boot guarantees.
